scriptComments: Edit these values after you change the looks of the plane and edited the cargo, fuel and passenger limits on the left by right clicking them and setting min and max.

Welcome to the code!Remixing:A lot here is really hard to understand but if you want to add another plane, for example an a320, you can follow the steps below.* Change the looks of the plane in the plane sprite.* Change the maximum fuel, cargo and passenger capacity.* Change the values in the "MOD HERE" sprite.* Edit anything else that you may need.After that your project should work.Copying:It's fine if you copy some scripts or ideas, just credit me in your credits.
